name: CN_RS_RULES_INT
description: Interface table for  CRM high volume import of incentive compensation  Rule Object.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: This is the SYSTASK_ID for a given Job in MKT_IMP_JOBS

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by import wizard to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: INTERFACE_ROW_ID is the unique identifier for the record with in a batch.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: The column saves the individual sys task id for each input csv file, corresponding to value in the mkt_cm_systask table.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates import wizard if the import to base table was successful or Errored out

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This is an optional column and would be useful if consumers want any error message as the first error.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Specifies insert or update operation to be performed on a record.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Used by the ODI import logic

columns.name: RULE_NUMBER
columns.description: The public unique identifier.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of base table CN_RS_RULES_ALL_B.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the rule

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the rule

columns.description: Indicates the name of the parent rule

columns.description: Indicates the business unit of the parent

columns.name: PARENT_USAGE_ID

columns.name: PARENT_END_DATE
columns.description: End Date of the parent rule

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this rule and all its children are active or not.

columns.name: USAGE_ID
columns.description: Indicates Rule usage. Foreign key to cn_rs_usages_all.usage_id

columns.name: USAGE_NAME
columns.description: USAGE_NAME  Indicates the rule usage name

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ORG_NAME
columns.description: BUSINESS_UNIT_NAMEE Indicates the name of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start Date of the rule

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End Date of the rule

columns.name: RANK
columns.description: Rank of the rule

columns.name: NUM_WINNERS
columns.description: Number of Winners

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
